info.title: MICROSERVICE-DocTest-List Mortgage Loans Status-v2-spec
info.description: The Mortgage Loans Status API provides a comprehensive way to access the current statuses of various mortgage loans. This endpoint allows users to retrieve detailed information regarding loan applications, including approval status, outstanding requirements, and processing updates. Typical consumers of this API include financial institutions, loan officers, and developers integrating loan management systems. By leveraging this API, organizations can streamline their loan tracking processes and enhance customer service through timely updates.

get.description: This endpoint allows users to obtain the current status of loans associated with their account. It returns detailed information about the loans including approval status, payment deadlines, and any outstanding balances.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve the status of loans. It should contain the necessary data required to query the loan statuses. Please ensure that the data adheres to the schema defined.

200.description: Successfully fetched the current status of loans.

ListMortgageLoansStatusRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for the GET operation related to loan statuses.

ListMortgageLoansStatusResponse_200.title: Loan Status Response

status.description: Indicates whether the operation was successful.

referenceNumber.description: A unique reference number for the loan transaction.

resultId.description: An identifier for the result of the operation.

state.description: The current state of the loan operation.

processingTimeMs.description: The time taken to process the request, in milliseconds.

message.description: A message providing additional information about the operation.

ListMortgageLoansStatusResponse_200.description: This schema represents the response after fetching the status of a loan operation.

AuditInfo.title: Audit Information

createdBy.description: The user who created the loan record.

createdAt.description: The timestamp when the loan record was created.

automated.description: Indicates whether the operation was automated.

AuditInfo.description: Contains information about the audit of the loan operation.

x-processing-time.description: Indicates the time taken to process the request, measured in milliseconds.
